clues.text: This compact coaster stands 40 feet tall, reaches a top speed of 33 mph, and features zero inversions.
Built by Gravitykraft Corporation, this attraction welcomed its very first riders in 2014.
You can find this ride entertaining families in the state of New Hampshire.
This wooden coaster is one of the signature thrill rides at Story Land.
The attraction's name is a punny portmanteau blending a ferocious beast's loud vocalization with a prehistoric dinosaur suffix.
